headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 30, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The San Diego Padres also secured a win, defeating the Washington Nationals 7-5 behind Curtis Mead's 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Reds placing right-handed pitcher Pierce Johnson on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Miami Marlins also placed left-handed pitcher Andrew Nardi on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28, 2026, due to a left rib cage stress reaction.

Several trades and roster moves were announced, including the Detroit Tigers trading right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for right fielder Rece Hinds.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Reds 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Nationals 7-5**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 7-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Mason Miller earned the save, pitching 1.1 innings with 2 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 5-6 decision to the Pittsburgh Pirates in a closely contested matchup. Trevor Larnach led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mason Fluharty earning the win and Braydon Fisher securing the save.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to White Sox in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers suffered a 7-1 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Spencer Torkelson and Wenceel Pérez contributing for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Reds RHP Pierce Johnson Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds right-handed pitcher Pierce Johnson has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
